summary: Re-scoped by operator-directed Revision 1 from cutting MINUTES to cutting CONTEXT, after Session 1 refuted the 2.3x the original scope rested on. MEASURED FIRST: guidance_report --check reproduced the spec's Section 4 exactly -- 11,644 preload tokens across four files, every one at 100% of its ceiling. Decomposing lessons-learned.md found the file that exists to carry lessons was spending 1,371 tokens (60% of its budget) on five tables recording where lessons USED to live, against 436 tokens (19%) of live lessons -- three of them, not the four the spec assumed. CUT, LARGEST FIRST: those five tables archived whole to lessons-archive.md (-1,418 tok, -62% of the file); five sections removed in lockstep from AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / GEMINI.md that were pure pointers session-constitution.md already carries INSIDE the same preload, so they were paid twice and bought once (-275 tok, the Set 121 S4 precedent applied to a second surface); and five TODO stubs moved out of project-guidance.md to the uncapped guidance-lifecycle.md, consumer-repo scaffolding that 134 sets paid for and no session ever filled in (-149 tok). PRELOAD 11,644 -> 9,802 TOKENS, -15.8%, read every session of every set. No lesson id was lost: validate_guidance_meta counts the same 49 before and after, and guidance_search --archive still finds every archived id. All four ceilings ratcheted to measurement (total 11,644 -> 9,802; lessons-learned 2,269 -> 851; project-guidance 3,394 -> 3,245; GEMINI.md 1,922 -> 1,647), journaled as a deliberate choice to bank the win as recurring saving rather than headroom -- and the mechanism then fired on this session, when adding the artifact-cap line put the constitution 2 tokens over and 11 characters had to come out of the same edit to pay for it. PER-SESSION CEREMONY: measured every artifact a session writes every time and ruled on each. Capped by CONVENTION, not by validator -- activity-log step description at 40 words (corpus mean 69.8 over 3,130 entries and 218,391 words), ai-assignment prose at 250 words per block, decisions.jsonl at 400 words per decision; worth 164,674 words applied to the corpus as it stands. EXEMPTED TWO ON EVIDENCE: sN-conventions.md, because capping what a paid verifier reads is a verification reduction and a hard operator carve-out, and disposition.json, whose shape is owed to a close gate rather than to discretion. A word-count validator on log_step was considered and refused as the framework's characteristic failure, reinforced by Session 2's finding that a refusal is only cheap where the caller can retry for free. THE SET FAILED ITS OWN LINE-COUNT TEST AND SAYS SO: net +646 lines against -206 out of the always-read tier. The verification round-trip alone (+325) cost more lines than the entire preload cut removed, and this change log (+195) is nearly the size of the cut it reports. Stated as a failed outcome in change-log.md under a heading that says so, per the spec's explicit instruction not to explain it away. The sharpest self-indictment is measured: Set 134 ran at 250.6 words per activity-log entry, the HIGHEST of all 126 sets with a log, against a corpus mean of 69.8 -- a set convened to cut ceremony wrote 3.6x the corpus average of the one artifact it was measuring. Session 3 held to its own cap at 25.7 w/entry, which shows the cap is livable. VERIFICATION: round 1 discovery (gpt-5.5, fan-out 2) returned two blocking Majors, the same defect from both lenses -- a scratch Python helper left at the repo root in a session whose rule is no-new-module and whose own conventions block asserted no Python module was added. Accepted without argument, fixed by removal, no replacement file and no gitignore entry. The transferable half: a scope claim in a conventions block is an assertion about the TREE, true of the intended diff and false of the actual one, and nothing on this side checked the two against each other. Supplementary and remediation-review both VERIFIED, 1 fix accepted, 0 rejected, within bounds. No by-design exclusion was challenged. SUITES: all three owed by covers ai_router/ and run in full after the last edit -- pytest 5,195 passed / 9 skipped / 1 xfailed; mocha 1,609 passing; playwright recorded as an explicitly composite pass under G-004 (36 passed / 1 failed at a 300s timeout under full-suite load, the identical spec passing alone in 46s with a TypeScript-free diff). That is the SECOND session of this set to hit the same flake on the same spec, so it is carried as a residual with a named owner rather than a curiosity.
